user.title: Food deals
user.description: Name the integration and choose the country to search deals in.

settings.title: Settings – {country}
settings.description: You type the groceries in the card (orange basket). Here you set where and how to search.

data.show_map: Show a map of the stores in the card
data.location_entity: Location for finding stores (empty = HA home)
data.nearby_only: Only stores with a branch within the radius
data.exclude_loyalty: Skip deals that need a loyalty card/app
data.include_upcoming: Also show upcoming deals (from new flyers)
data.custom_urls: Custom URLs (one per line, {query} / {slug} = searched item)

data_description.show_map: The card shows a map with numbered stores below the store list. Can be turned off in the card as well.
data_description.location_entity: Phone or person – stores are searched around it. Outside the selected country, home is used.
data_description.nearby_only: Deals from chains without a branch within the radius are hidden.

search.name: Search groceries on sale
search.description: Finds where the given groceries are on sale cheapest in nearby stores. The result is in the Search results sensor and in the service response.

items.name: Groceries
items.description: One or more items separated by comma or new line, e.g. “milk, bread, butter”. Empty = repeat the last search.

config_entry_id.name: Integration
config_entry_id.description: Which instance to use (Czechia / Slovakia). Empty = first.
